title: Apple Refreshes the Mac Mini and Mac Studio, Both With New AI-Ready Chips
summary: Apple has announced fresh versions of the Mac Mini and Mac Studio desktop computers, alongside some new chips: the M6 and M5 Ultra. M5 Ultra Mac Studio comes with four more CPU cores for a total of 36.
